title: A2A Local Transport Message
description: Structured message envelope for the ELIS local A2A transport layer. This schema carries no governance or merge authority. It is a passive internal transport only.

message_id.description: Unique identifier for this message (UUID v4).

recipient.description: Name of the receiving agent or 'broadcast' for all agents.

message_type.description: Type of message. Determines expected payload structure.

payload.description: Message payload. Content schema depends on message_type. Must be an object; may be empty ({}).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of message creation.

pe_id.description: Optional PE identifier this message relates to (e.g. 'PE-OPS-A2A-RUNTIME-01').
